messages:
Jordan (CS): quick recap from onboarding calls this week — three recurring asks: bulk dataset import + schema mapping, per-route token/cost visibility, and route-level model pinning/fallbacks. attaching tickets: #CS-983 #CS-987 #CS-990
zendesk-bot: Linked tickets: https://zendesk.example.com/t/983 , https://zendesk.example.com/t/987 , https://zendesk.example.com/t/990
Maya (CS Lead): which of these are driving renewals? need to flag high-risk accounts.
Jordan (CS): Acme (renewing in ~6w) — importer is blocking onboarding. Brightlane (10w) — cost visibility blocking rollout. NeonHealth — policy/compliance ask for pinning. all three asked for ETA.
Sam (PM): thanks — can you paste a one-line pain + severity (1-5) for each customer?
Jordan (CS): Acme: "onboarding blocked by lack of safe bulk import; ~10M rows" — severity 5. Brightlane: "no per-route cost breakdown; sudden token spikes" — severity 4. NeonHealth: "must pin model versions for audit/compliance" — severity 4. plus smaller asks: better sample prompts in console, clearer error codes.
Anita (Product Ops): proposal — tag tickets with voc:onboarding / voc:cost / voc:compliance and capture a direct customer quote field. I'll add an impact column in the backlog sheet.
Leo (Eng): importer scope question: full schema mapping UI vs CSV template + basic validation. low-effort path is CSV template + import docs. spike estimate: 2w.
Maya (CS Lead): propose quick-win roadmap: 1) CSV template + step-by-step import docs, 2) per-route token export (CSV) + simple dashboard, 3) assessment plan for model-pinning (design doc). prioritize 1 then 2. :thumbsup:
Sam (PM): agreed. I'll open a GH epic and add tasks. @Jordan — can you paste the verbatim customer quotes so I can include them in ticket descriptions?
Jordan (CS): sending quotes now: "Acme: onboarding blocked by lack of safe bulk import — we have 10M rows to bring in" / "Brightlane: can't explain sudden cost spikes per route" / "NeonHealth: need pinning to ensure approved model version"
Sam (PM): epic created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmap/issues/412 — added initial tasks for CSV template + docs and per-route CSV export.
Anita (Product Ops): scheduling 30m triage with Product + Eng tomorrow 11:00 PT. please RSVP.
Maya (CS Lead): +1. I'll prep a short slide with renewal risk and suggested customer comms.
Jordan (CS): heads up — customers asked for ETA ranges; please avoid saying "months" in comms. even "2 weeks for docs" is better. :eyes:
Leo (Eng): noting technical blockers for pinning: model storage + routing + fallback policy. will draft a short tech-constraints note in the epic.
Sam (PM): thanks all. next steps: Anita to run triage invite, Jordan to tag tickets + add quotes, Leo to spike importer approach (2w), Sam to triage prioritization in roadmap sync.
Maya (CS Lead): thanks — will follow up with customers after triage. :thumbsup:
